### Disabled fee query shows loading skeleton **Medium Severity** `useFeeQuote` disables the request when notional is zero, but TanStack Query v5 still sets `isPending` on a disabled query with no data. `FeePreview` treats that flag as an in-flight fetch, so an empty order amount keeps a skeleton instead of the missing-quote fallback.
Additional Locations (2) - [`src/features/perpetuals/order/queries/fee-quote.ts#L31-L34`](https://github.com/consensys-vertical-apps/va-mmcx-terminal/blob/373520256ed4e07d6efdfb2e0542a7206e46cc15/src/features/perpetuals/order/queries/fee-quote.ts#L31-L34) - [`src/features/perpetuals/order/components/OrderForm/OrderFormSummary/OrderFormSummary.tsx#L120-L125`](https://github.com/consensys-vertical-apps/va-mmcx-terminal/blob/373520256ed4e07d6efdfb2e0542a7206e46cc15/src/features/perpetuals/order/components/OrderForm/OrderFormSummary/OrderFormSummary.tsx#L120-L125)

Fixed in af81d282: order and close previews use isLoading so disabled queries show Fees unavailable; typecheck, changed-file lint and all 33 affected tests pass.

### Fee quotes reset on live prices **High Severity** Live `marketPrice` ticks change the exact `notional` in the `useFeeQuote` query key, so React Query starts a new empty query. `FeePreview` then swaps the last quote for a skeleton. Limit opens and market closes reprice off the unthrottled mid, so the fee row can stay loading while prices stream.
